meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Teams 适配器复制到 src/channels 并注册、装上固定版本的适配器包，再用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、把凭据写进 .env，最后让助手主动给你的 Teams 账号发第一条消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 加上 Microsoft Teams，或想把助手接入 Teams 频道、群聊、私聊时触发。若 .env 里已有 Teams 凭据，创建与提问步骤会被跳过，直接进入重启。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Microsoft Teams 集成
say.note: 复制适配器、注册并跑集成测试

say.text: 用 NanoClaw 这个名字创建 Teams 机器人
say.note: 调用 Teams CLI 创建并写入 .env

say.text: 把助手接到我的 Teams 账号上
say.note: 先建私聊，助手会先发消息给你

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams support via the Chat SDK bridge: copies the Teams adapter into src/channels, registers it, adds the adapter package, creates a bot with the Teams CLI, writes .env credentials, and has the assistant message you first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Microsoft Teams to NanoClaw. If .env already holds a Teams credential, the creation and prompt steps are skipped and the flow goes straight to restart.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams integration to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs the test.

say_en.text: Create the Teams bot named NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the Teams CLI and writes credentials to .env.

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account.
say_en.note: Creates the bot-to-you chat so it messages first.
